name: Sundrel Post 28 Original
description: This listing is a benthic-range pressure calibrator listed with accuracy class 0.75 percent, operating temperature -40 degrees Celsius, sampling rate 1316.6 hertz. Its remaining stated figures are calibration interval 25 months, unit price set after acceptance, mounting tripod. Every one of them is quoted from the same six axes the other listings in this category are described on.
